title: AtlasMind Buzz persona teams
description: The project's intent for Buzz personas: each persona is one Buzz identity backed by a team of AtlasMind agents. This file is committed, so it holds no Buzz key, no workspace path, no provider credential and no channel history — AtlasMind refuses the whole file if it finds one. Creating the Buzz identity is a separate step.

id.description: Stable id. Changing it makes a different persona.

agentIds.description: The only agents this persona may select or hand off to. One agent may serve several personas.

preferredAgentId.description: Answers when no member matches the request. Must be one of agentIds.

independenceClass.description: `oversight` personas review and should use a read-only skill ceiling. An oversight agent inside an `execution` persona is reported as no longer independent.

oneOf.description: Each member keeps its own skills. Members never share skills.
Each member keeps only the skills it has that are also in this list.
